children: Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (FCX) filed a Form 8K - Other Events - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 08, 2026.

On September 1, 2026, PT Freeport Indonesia (PTFI), Freeport-McMoRan Inc.'s 48.76%-owned subsidiary, amended and restated its $1.75 billion, senior unsecured revolving credit facility to, among other things, extend the maturity date under the facility from November 2028 to September 2031. As of September 1, 2026, PTFI had $250 million in borrowings outstanding under its revolving credit facility. PTFI's revolving credit facility is available for its general corporate purposes.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/831259/000083125926000038/fcx-20260901.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/831259/000083125926000038/0000831259-26-000038-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
